desc:
🎁 YOU'RE TRAPPED IN SANTA'S WORKSHOP... AND YOU HAVE TO WRAP 1,000,000 PRESENTS TO ESCAPE?!?!

🎅 You took a holiday job at Santa's Workshop...
🚪 Now you're LOCKED in the basement, and WRAPPING PRESENTS is your only way out.

🎁 Use ridiculous tools to wrap presents (Tape Gun, Paint Roller, Paper Minigun...)
💎 Earn gems & buy powerful upgrades
🤖 Unlock Robot Arms, 3D Present Printers & Present Cannons that wrap for you
😈 Survive Hard & Nightmare mode
🔓 Discover the dark secrets hidden around the workshop
🏆 Earn Badges & race for the fastest escape on the Leaderboards
👥 Get locked in with up to 3 friends and escape together

👀 But... what happened to all of Santa's elves?

🎁 Join the group for a FREE Auto Wrap!
👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to support the game!

🔍 Tags: incremental, simulator, clicking, christmas, presents, escape, funny, automation, upgrades, tycoon, idle, santa, secrets
